pages.title: Getting Started
pages.description: How to install and set up Semistrap

sections.title: Installation
sections.content: Download the latest release from GitHub and run the installer. You will need the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime if not already installed.

sections.title: System Requirements
sections.content: Semistrap requires Windows 10 or later and the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime.

sections.title: First Launch
sections.content: On first launch, Semistrap will guide you through the initial setup wizard where you can configure your preferences.

sections.title: Discord Rich Presence
sections.content: Show your friends what Roblox game you're playing directly on your Discord profile. Configure display options in Settings > Integrations.

sections.title: Content Modding
sections.content: Customize Roblox content files such as death sounds, mouse cursors, and other assets.

sections.title: Server Location
sections.content: See the geographical location of the Roblox server you're connected to, powered by ipinfo.io.

sections.title: Graphics Configuration
sections.content: Configure graphics fidelity and UI experience settings for Roblox.

sections.title: General Settings
sections.content: Basic application settings including language, theme, and startup behavior.

sections.title: Integrations
sections.content: Configure Discord Rich Presence and other third-party integrations.

sections.title: Appearance
sections.content: Customize the look and feel of Semistrap including icons and themes.

sections.title: Bootstrapper Settings
sections.content: Configure how Roblox is launched and managed by Semistrap.

sections.title: Windows SmartScreen Warning
sections.content: Windows SmartScreen may show a warning on first launch. Click 'More info' and then 'Run anyway' to proceed.

sections.title: Installation Issues
sections.content: If installation fails, ensure you have the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime installed and try running as administrator.

sections.title: Discord Rich Presence Not Working
sections.content: Ensure Discord is running before launching Roblox. Check that Rich Presence is enabled in Settings > Integrations.

sections.title: Roblox Not Launching
sections.content: Try reinstalling Semistrap. If the issue persists, check the Semistrap logs for error details.

sections.title: Is Semistrap malware?
sections.content: No. The source code is fully open source and viewable on GitHub. Semistrap does not contain any malicious code.

sections.title: Can using Semistrap get me banned?
sections.content: No. Semistrap does not interact with the Roblox client in the same way that exploits do. It is a legitimate bootstrapper replacement.

sections.title: What are the official download sources?
sections.content: The only official sources are this GitHub repository and semistrap.vercel.app. Do not download Semistrap from any other website.

sections.title: How is Semistrap different from Bloxstrap?
sections.content: Semistrap is a fork of Bloxstrap with additional features, removed analytics, and active maintenance by the Semistrap team.

sections.title: Reporting Issues
sections.content: Found a bug? Open an issue on GitHub with detailed steps to reproduce the problem.

sections.title: Development Setup
sections.content: Semistrap is built with .NET 10 and WPF. Clone the repository and open in Visual Studio 2022 or later to start developing.

sections.title: Pull Requests
sections.content: Contributions are welcome! Fork the repository, make your changes, and submit a pull request.
